character:burak:male_professional.voice_name: Eyüp Tulûhan Etker - Deep and Rich
character:burak:male_professional.description: This voice provides a natural and fluent Turkish speech experience with a native accent. It features a strong, clear, and well-articulated tone, making it ideal for commercials, news, documentaries, and narration projects. The voice can be energetic, enthusiastic, and engaging while also being suitable for formal or calm delivery. It is optimized for commercial use, podcast content, and AI-driven voice applications.

character:deniz:female_calm.description: A clear, natural-sounding female voice trained on diverse topics. Each sentence ends with a gentle, reassuring tone. Ideal for educational videos, social media content, podcasts, and motivational narration. Creates a warm connection with the listener, leaving them feeling calm and supported.

character:elif:female_warm.voice_name: Gozde Arikan - Soft, Warm and Clear
character:elif:female_warm.description: Young Turkish girl with a soft, pleasant and natural ton. It’s ideal for narration also storytelling. It also suits well to English and other languages.

character:emre:male_calm.description: A warm, natural, and friendly tone. Ideal for everyday conversations, narrations, storytelling, and informative content. Its smooth transitions and balanced emphasis easily connect with listeners. Clear pronunciation and clear diction make it comfortable to listen to even long content.

character:kaan:male_bright.description: This voice features a young, energetic, and friendly style, delivering a natural tone with humor and warmth. It conveys a youthful perspective, quickly building a connection with the listener. This voice is especially suitable for entertainment, simulation games, or casual conversation content. With an engaging, approachable, and dynamic approach, it’s perfect for projects aimed at a younger audience, creating a strong impact.

character:mert:male_warm.description:
Hello! I'm Talha. I love bringing emotions to life, breathing soul into stories, and giving character to every word I speak!

🔹 Warm and reassuring tone – Captivates listeners in storytelling.
🔹 Powerful and charismatic voice – Leaves a strong impact in everything from commercials to documentaries.
🔹 Natural, friendly, and energetic – Perfect for fun projects and character voiceovers!

If you're looking for a voice that blends emotion and quality, you've come to the right place!

character:selin:female_bright.description: Tugba is a warm, confident Turkish female voice with a naturally inviting tone. She speaks in smooth, melodious phrases—lightly flirtatious yet always professional—perfect for customer-facing calls, product demos, and brand messaging. Her delivery is clear and energetic, with subtle pauses and expressive inflections that make every invitation sound personal and genuine.

character:zeynep:female_professional.description: A calm, natural female voice with clear articulation, a warm and trustworthy tone, and a smooth documentary-style narration.
